name: Nicolás Maduro
role: President of Venezuela (2013–2026); captured by US forces in January 2026 and held in New York pending trial
summary: Maduro led Venezuela as Hugo Chávez's chosen successor under the banner of Bolivarian socialism, keeping state control of oil, price and currency controls, social missions and an anti-US, multipolar foreign policy. He governed by decree, convened the 2017 Constituent Assembly, and relied on the military while opposition leaders faced arrest and media faced closures. After 2019 sanctions his government loosened some economic controls and tolerated dollarization.
